" alt="Draft Edge football and blade logo"></div>
      <div class="brand-copy">
        <div class="brand-title">DRAFT EDGE</div>
        <div class="brand-tagline">RANK • DRAFT • DOMINATE</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="nav">
    <button class="active" data-page="adp">Current ADP</button>
    <button data-page="rankings">My Rankings</button>
    <button data-page="draft">Live Draft</button>
  </div>

  <section id="page-adp" class="page active">
    <div class="pagehead">
      <div><h2>Current ADP</h2><p>Sleeper's current draft-board order. Refreshes on page load or with Update Current ADP.</p></div>
      <div class="small" id="adpStatus"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="filter-indicator" id="adpFilterIndicator"></div>
      <input class="search" id="adpSearch" placeholder="Search players…">
      <div class="pills" id="adpPills"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="adpList" class="rank-list"></div>
  </section>

  <section id="page-rankings" class="page">
    <div class="pagehead">
      <div><h2>My Rankings</h2><p>ALL is your overall ranking list. Position tabs show My Pos Rank. Tiers are completely optional and only appear when you create them.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="filter-indicator" id="rankFilterIndicator"></div>
      <input class="search" id="rankSearch" placeholder="Search your rankings…">
      <div class="pills" id="rankPills"></div>
      <button class="btn" id="addPlayerBtn">＋ Add Player</button>
      <button class="btn" id="addTier">＋ Tier</button>
    </div>
    <div id="rankList" class="rank-list"></div>
  </section>

  <section id="page-draft" class="page">
    <div class="pagehead"><div><h2>Live Draft</h2><p>Connect a Sleeper draft to cross players off automatically, or mark them drafted manually here. Drafted players disappear from the live list and stay available inside the Drafted tab for quick undo.</p></div></div>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="filter-indicator" id="draftFilterIndicator"></div>
      <input class="search" id="draftSearch" placeholder="Search available players…">
      <div class="pills" id="draftPills"></div>
      <input class="search" id="draftId" placeholder="Sleeper draft ID" style="max-width:270px">
      <button class="btn primary" id="connectDraft">Connect</button>
      <button class="btn" id="stopDraft">Stop</button><button class="btn" id="draftedTab">Drafted · <span id="draftedCount">0</span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="small" id="draftState" style="margin:-18px 0 20px">Not connected</div>
    <div id="draftList" class="rank-list"></div>
  </section>
</div>


<input type="file" id="rankingFileInput" accept=".csv,text/csv" hidden>
<button class="side-tag-tab" id="openTagDrawer"><span>TAG VIEWS</span><span id="tagTabDot" class="tag-tab-dot"></span></button>
<div class="drawer-backdrop" id="tagDrawerBackdrop"></div>
<div class="left-drawer" id="tagDrawer">
  <button class="close" id="closeTagDrawer">×</button>
  <h2 style="margin:0">Tag Views</h2>
  <div class="small">Jump to all players that match a certain tag.</div>
  <div id="tagFilterList" class="tag-list"></div>
</div>

<div class="modal" id="editModal"><div class="modalbox">
  <button class="close" id="closeEdit">×</button>
  <h2>Tags & Note</h2><div class="small" id="editPlayerName"></div>
  <div class="section"><h3>Quick Tags</h3><div class="tagpicker" id="tagPicker"></div></div>
  <div class="section"><h3>Your Note</h3><textarea id="noteInput" class="note" placeholder="e.g. Take every time in Round 8."></textarea></div>
  <div class="section" style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px"><button class="btn" id="cancelEdit">Cancel</button><button class="btn primary" id="saveEdit">Save</button></div>
</div></div>

<div class="modal" id="tierModal"><div class="modalbox" style="width:min(460px,calc(100vw - 40px))">
  <button class="close" id="closeTier">×</button>
  <h2>Edit Tier</h2><div class="small" id="tierContext"></div>
  <div class="section"><h3>Tier Name</h3><div class="formline"><input id="tierNameInput"><button class="btn primary" id="saveTier">Save</button></div></div>
</div></div>

<div class="modal" id="settingsModal"><div class="modalbox settings-box">
  <button class="close" id="closeSettings">×</button>
  <h2>Settings</h2>
  <div class="settings-grid">
    <div class="settings-section">
      <h3>Data & Rankings</h3>
      <div class="small">Each ranking list has its own rankings, tiers, tags, notes and draft state.</div>
      <div class="settings-actions">
        <button class="btn primary" id="newListSettings">＋ New Ranking List</button>
        <button class="btn" id="importRankings">Import Rankings</button>
        <button class="btn" id="exportRankings">Export Current List</button>
        <button class="btn" id="duplicateList">Duplicate List</button>
        <button class="btn" id="renameList">Rename List</button>
        <button class="btn danger-soft" id="deleteList">Delete List</button>
      </div>
      <div class="settings-note">Imports intentionally <b>do not</b> create tiers or notes automatically.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="settings-section">
      <h3>Account</h3>
      <div class="account-state" id="accountState">
        <div>
          <b id="accountStateTitle">Local Preview</b>
          <div class="small" id="accountStateText">Your lists are currently saved only in this browser.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="settings-actions compact">
          <button class="btn primary" id="accountSettingsBtn">Sign In / Create Account</button>
          <button class="btn" id="signOutBtn" style="display:none">Sign Out</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="settings-note" id="accountSettingsNote">Use your email and password to sync your ranking lists across devices.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="settings-section">
      <h3>Current ADP</h3>
      <div class="small">Current ADP uses Sleeper's current player-board order. ADP history is stored locally in this browser.</div>
      <div class="settings-actions"><button class="btn" id="resetAll">Reset Current List</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div></div>

<div class="modal" id="newListModal"><div class="modalbox create-list-box">
  <button class="close" id="closeNewList">×</button>
  <h2>Create Ranking List</h2>
  <div class="small">Name it whatever you want. Nothing is pre-labeled for you.</div>
  <div class="section">
    <h3>List Name</h3>
    <input class="wide-input" id="newListName" placeholder="e.g. 2026 Full PPR">
  </div>
  <div class="create-options">
    <button class="create-option" data-create="scratch">
      <span class="create-icon">＋</span><b>Start From Scratch</b>
      <small>Begin empty, then add players yourself or import later.</small>
    </button>
    <button class="create-option featured" data-create="adp">
      <span class="create-icon">↗</span><b>Start From Current ADP</b>
      <small>Copy Sleeper's current order into a fully editable personal list.</small>
    </button>
    <button class="create-option" data-create="import">
      <span class="create-icon">⇧</span><b>Import Rankings</b>
      <small>Import player order and rank data from a CSV file.</small>
    </button>
  </div>
  <div class="small create-foot">New lists start with <b>no tiers</b>, <b>no notes</b> and <b>no tags</b>.</div>
</div></div>

<div class="modal" id="importPreviewModal"><div class="modalbox" style="width:min(650px,calc(100vw - 40px))">
  <button class="close" id="closeImportPreview">×</button>
  <h2>Import Preview</h2>
  <div class="small" id="importSummary"></div>
  <div class="import-preview" id="importPreview"></div>
  <div class="formline" style="margin-top:16px"><input id="importListName" placeholder="Ranking list name"><button class="btn primary" id="confirmImport">Create List</button></div>
  <div class="settings-note">Tier and note columns are ignored on purpose. You can add those yourself afterward.</div>
</div></div>

<div class="modal" id="addPlayerModal"><div class="modalbox" style="width:min(680px,calc(100vw - 40px))">
  <button class="close" id="closeAddPlayer">×</button>
  <h2>Add Player</h2>
  <div class="small">Add players to the end of your current list. Their positional rank is assigned automatically, but no tier is created.</div>
  <input class="wide-input" id="addPlayerSearch" placeholder="Search Sleeper players…" style="margin-top:14px">
  <div class="player-picker" id="playerPicker"></div>
</div></div>

<div class="modal" id="draftedModal"><div class="modalbox" style="width:min(620px,calc(100vw - 40px))">
  <button class="close" id="closeDrafted">×</button>
  <h2>Drafted Players</h2>
  <div class="small">Players crossed off in Live Draft. Undo any pick here.</div>
  <div id="draftedList" class="drafted-list"></div>
</div></div>

<div class="drawer" id="drawer"><div class="drawerbox"><button class="close" id="closeDrawer">×</button><div id="drawerContent"></div></div></div>
